title: Number sense and operations
summary: NCERT learning outcomes include understanding place value and using number operations to solve contextual problems. This is a learning domain, not a textbook chapter title.

title: Fractions and decimals
summary: NCERT learning outcomes include representing and comparing fractions and connecting familiar fractions with decimal notation. This is a learning domain, not a textbook chapter title.

title: Measurement and units
summary: NCERT learning outcomes include selecting and using standard measures in everyday situations. This is a learning domain, not a textbook chapter title.

title: Shapes and spatial understanding
summary: NCERT learning outcomes include describing, comparing, and reasoning about common two-dimensional and three-dimensional shapes. This is a learning domain, not a textbook chapter title.

title: Data handling
summary: NCERT learning outcomes include reading, organising, and interpreting simple data representations. This is a learning domain, not a textbook chapter title.
